My plot is small, only 0.06 hectares, and I am planting yam and cassava together as I have always done. I will put small chemical fertilizer because the soil is tired from planting year after year, but I cannot afford much — maybe one bag of NPK to share across my plots. I will also carry goat and chicken droppings from my compound to the plot, that one costs me nothing. I use the cassava cuttings and yam seed from last year's harvest because improved ones are expensive and not always easy to find in my village, and I depend on the rain since I have no pump or borehole.
